cache_iterator_basic: cache a data loader iterator with a fixed number of cached batches for benchmarking
cache_iterator_with_stop: cache an iterator and stop after a specified number of total iterations including cached values
cache_iterator_defer_return: cache an iterator and defer returning cached values until after a specified number of source iterations
cache_iterator_no_delete: cache an iterator without deleting the source data loader to preserve resources for later use
cache_iterator_benchmark: wrap a data loader with cache_iterator to benchmark whether training is bottlenecked by data loading
